svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 5 (CUMULATIVE R485 MILESTONE) · AUTONOMOUS SOFTWARE FACTORY & QA
openfabriq (Factory as Code) + bubbleptr/aoa (24x7 SQLite SDK) + mobile-agent-testers (20-Phone QA)
1. openfabriq/openfabriq (★10 · Apache-2.0 · Node 24+)
• Declarative "openfabriq/" Software Factory (plan / apply / start)
Triage, implement, review & fix GitHub issues labeled ready-for-agent
Agents NEVER hold GitHub credentials; 4-column board tracks cost; humans merge
2. bubbleptr/aoa (★12 · Bun 1.3 + SQLite · MIT · C1-C20)
• 24x7 Inbox + Worker model backed by a single shared SQLite file (agent.db)
• High-risk tools (risk: "high") pause in kernel & emit [approval_request]
• Executes once and only once after agent.answer(callId, { verdict: "approve" })
• Survives process kills via dedupeKey; supports piRuntime, Codex & dsh
3. pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers (★34 · MIT)
• 20 Parallel AI Testers on 10 iOS + 10 Android Simulators ($0 Infra)
Zero test scripts to write; covers Flutter, React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Swift, MAUI
Each agent plays a distinct persona across 14 languages, 200% font scale & RTL
• Empirical LocalSend (100k ★) Findings (anonymized_reported)
103 reports ➔ 46 distinct bugs (1 blocker, 15 major) in 69 minutes
29 of 46 bugs (63.0%) were discovered by only a single device/locale persona!
Real Visual Bugs Missed by Traditional Selector Tests:
• iPhone SE Swedish largest text: message dialog overflows 149 px (hides Confirm)
• Pixel 7 at 200% font: all 6 Send buttons cut in half; iPad German +114 px overflow
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R5-OPENFABRIQ-AOA-MOBILEQA · 50 ENGINEERS, $100/HR)
• Path A (Manual Triage + Raw Scripts + Appium Device Farm): $2,550.00 infra + $4,200.00 labor (42.0h) = $6,750.00 / mo
• Path B (Commercial Coding Bot SaaS + Crowdtesting): $1,180.00 SaaS/QA + $1,850.00 labor (18.5h) = $3,030.00 / mo
• Path C (openfabriq + aoa SQLite + mobile-agent-testers): $105.00 CI/tokens + $310.00 labor (3.1h) = $415.00 / mo (-$6,335.00/mo · -93.85%)
